column4: tex 1550-1552: for clopen P with T(P) subset P and D = P minus T(P) nonempty, the cell of R_X has u, p = 1_P, d = 1_D != 0, f_ab = u^a d u^(-b). Introduces notation for a given P; existence of P is not asserted by the sentence.
tex 1552-1553: f_ab f_ce = if b = c then f_ae else 0 in R_X for the cell of P.
tex 1553: every negative level T^-(n+1)(D) is disjoint from P; algebraically p f_ab = 0 (a<0) and f_ab p = 0 (b<0).
tex 1554-1555: S = Subring.closure {s, t, kp} in the corner pR_Xp (identity p); s = up, t = pu^-1, kp = a*p lie in S; ts = p and st = p - 1_D.
tex 1556-1557: S is a finitely generated ring and EL_3(S) has property (T); the EJZ citation is the repository's proved theorem ejz (no hypothesis argument).
tex 1557-1558: g -> diag(1-p) + g is an injective hom EL_3(S) -> GL_3(R_X) with image coreGroup over S, and that image has property (T).
